name: Mojo Sauce
subtitle: From Greta
notes: Another divine Greta contribution, discovered in 2025 by Mom. Great as a marinade/sauce for grilled chicken. Also good on pork or beef, or over rice, or with a cucumber and tomato salad, or with leftover chicken for chicken salad. This is YUMMY! Sherry vinegar is worth buying and keeping around.

steps.title: Combine the garlic and spices
steps.body: Combine and set aside: **12 cloves raw mashed garlic**, cayenne pepper to taste, **1 tsp kosher salt** and **4 tsp ground cumin**.

steps.title: Heat the oil
steps.body: Heat **1 cup olive oil** in a saucepan until just before it smokes. The oil should sizzle when cool ingredients are added.

steps.title: Add the garlic and spices
steps.body: Add combined spices and garlic, remove from heat, stir, and let stand for 10 minutes to cook the garlic slightly.

steps.title: Blend in the citrus
steps.body: Whisk in, or better yet, use an immersion blender to homogenize: **⅓ cup orange juice concentrate**, **⅓ cup lime juice**, **¼ cup brown sugar** and **1½ Tbsp sherry vinegar**.

steps.title: Season and cool
steps.body: Season with salt and pepper and set aside to cool completely.
